items.q: How is the monthly allowance expressed?
items.a: Plan allowances are measured in messages per month, not 24-hour conversations. You can check usage in the dashboard.

items.q: What happens when I reach my plan's message limit?
items.a: The AI assistant stops sending new automated replies and requests are passed to a human operator. You can upgrade your plan to increase the allowance.

items.q: Can I switch plans or cancel later?
items.a: Absolutely. You can upgrade, downgrade, or cancel anytime through the Stripe billing portal integrated in your settings.
